index.title: About Me
index.tooltip: In this section you will find personal information about my academic background and professional contact details.
index.personalInfoTooltip: Personal introduction including my background as a Computer Engineer and my professional focus on software development.
index.description: I am a Computer Engineer trained at the School of Computer Engineering at the University of Oviedo. My focus is on software development, ICT project management and innovation in the technology sector.

interests.title: Interests
interests.tooltip: Discover my areas of professional interest in technology and my personal passions outside the work environment.
interests.areasTooltip: My main areas of professional interest include software development, optimization and ICT project management.
interests.softwareDevDesc: I am interested in working in Full-Stack environments, applying modern technologies like Angular, Spring and client-server architectures.
interests.optimizationDesc: I seek to apply data science and artificial intelligence to mobility projects, energy efficiency and sustainability in ICT.
interests.projectMgmtDesc: I am interested in agile methodologies, ICT project planning and improving software development processes.
interests.footballDesc: Football is one of my great passions. I particularly follow Real Oviedo and enjoy recording and sharing moments related to this sport.
